title: onprem/airgap: offline bundle vendoring + RKE2 Ubuntu 22.04 EFI support & TUF updates
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Add support for EFI-based Ubuntu 22.04 RKE2 installs in the on-prem offline bundle; vendor required OS packages and container images; TUF metadata refresh and apt-mirror tooling improvements for air-gapped upgrades. Backwards-compatible; recommends customers retest upgrades in staging.
description:
Motivation: Several enterprise customers running RKE2 on Ubuntu 22.04 reported installer failures on EFI-enabled hosts and inconsistent behavior when applying air-gapped TUF metadata updates. This PR packages EFI-targeted offline artifacts, vendors additional distro packages used by the installer, and hardens the TUF update/rollback tooling used in the offline bundle.

What this PR does (single continuous description): Adds a new vendoring step and offline bundle payload for Ubuntu 22.04 EFI systems (rke2-ubuntu-22.04-efi.tar.gz). Vendors kernel modules and grub/EFI helpers required for a reliable installer path, pins OS-level packages used by the private-installer to known-good checksums, and expands the apt-mirror configuration for offline apt provisioning. Updates the TUF metadata rotation flow to support incremental snapshot rotations and adds a rollback helper script (tuf-rollback.sh) that performs safe metadata reversion and mirror rewrites. Includes helm chart bump for redwood-private-installer to 0.9.2 with templated EFI detection config and values for apt mirror endpoints. Adds unit and integration tests that run in the perf-canary infra and a small e2e canary job that simulates air-gapped boot on QEMU.

Checklist:
- [x] Add vendored offline artifacts for Ubuntu 22.04 EFI
- [x] Update TUF metadata and add rollback tooling
- [x] Helm chart bump + new values for EFI/apt-mirror
- [x] Tests: unit, integration, e2e canary (QEMU)
- [x] Docs: update airgap README with upgrade notes

Risk and compatibility: Changes are additive. The installer will continue to support non-EFI flows. TUF metadata rotation changed to be more conservative (incremental snapshots by default), and rollback helper is provided for safety. Recommend customers test the bundle in staging before rolling to production.

Related: ENG-8632, SUP-1298.
